subject: [COMPANY] | Scaling your multimodal data pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Was reading about your plans to advance core R&D and expand clinical
channels, post-raise. We started working with computer vision teams such as
Sewer AI, right around this same inflection point, when they were scaling
past early deployments and needed their data and model pipeline to keep up.

As [COMPANY] scales to more clinical settings and customers - the bottleneck
often shifts from cameras to data: labeling, curating, and iterating on
training data fast enough to keep up with new stool/urine imagery edge
cases that move the needle in model performance.

Encord is a multimodal data platform built for exactly that problem;
helping computer vision teams manage and improve training data at scale, so
model iteration doesn't become the thing slowing down deployment and path
to FDA approval.

If you could speed up model iteration, what would that mean for your goal
of speeding up model deployment, post-raise?
